ev.q: Eight poisoning cases were identified from the four events reported
all poisonings were determined to be low severity
Four events of poisoning associated with Zn 3 P 2 occurred in veterinary hospitals during 2006–2011.

methods_quotes.q: Cases were categorized by certainty of exposure, reported health effects, and consistency of health effects with known toxicology of the chemical
A poisoning case was defined as two or more acute adverse health effects consistent with PH 3 toxicity
Severity of poisoning cases can be categorized into four groups, using standardized criteria for state-based surveillance programs
